title: zazzle invoker component diagram
description: The invoker's source, its tests and its benchmarks, the daemon all three need, the standalone tools the invoker runs for `zazzle free-disk-space`, `zazzle fix-network` and `zazzle git`, and ai-agent, which `zazzle daemon llm` runs for `zazzle agent llm|prompt`. The same program, run as `zazz` or under an installed script's name, sends zazz requests to the daemon.

components.name: zazzle invoker
components.responsibility: Builds and tests the zazzle program.

components.name: Invoker source
components.responsibility: The program: logic, entry and per-platform syscalls.

components.name: Tests
components.responsibility: Host unit tests against a mock syscall layer, the gcov branch gate and the end-to-end smoke test, which also runs the invoker as `zazz` and as a script's shim.

components.name: Benchmarks
components.responsibility: Spawn-latency measurements of zazzle against a startup floor, a libc hello, grep and cat, and cold and warm refs timings.

components.name: daemon
components.responsibility: The daemon the invoker talks to, for zazzle commands (`agent get-rules` included) and (as zazz or a shim) zazz commands, and the binary it execs for `run`, `proxy`, `setup` and `agent llm|prompt`.

components.name: git-tools
components.responsibility: The git front end and commit message editor `zazzle git` runs.

components.name: ai-agent-rules
components.responsibility: The rule and skill finder behind `zazzle agent get-rules`, which the daemon links and answers through the daemon; its ai-agent-rules binary still runs it alone.

components.name: ai-agent
components.responsibility: Runs open models locally for `zazzle agent llm|prompt`; `zazzle daemon llm` downloads and execs it.

relationships.description: Sends every daemon command over its socket (prefixed `zazz` or `zazz exec-name NAME` when run under another name) and starts it when nothing listens; execs `zazzle daemon wrap`, `zazzle daemon proxy`, `zazzle daemon setup` and, for `agent llm|prompt`, `zazzle daemon llm`.
Execs the free-disk-space binary from the tools' folder (libexec/zazzle).
Execs the fix-network binary from the tools' folder (libexec/zazzle).
Execs the git-tools binary from the tools' folder (libexec/zazzle) for `zazzle git`.
Answers `zazzle agent get-rules` with the ai-agent-rules library and a per-session ledger.
`zazzle daemon llm` fetches ai-agent when needed and execs it.
unit.c includes zazzle_core.h with the mock; smoke.sh runs build/zazzle.
exit0.c reuses entry.h; run.sh and refs.sh time build/zazzle.
run.sh and refs.sh start the release daemon on a temporary socket; refs.sh also times `zazzle daemon run refs` cold.
